game.title: F.E.A.R. 3
game.blurb: First-person horror shooter from Day 1 Studios (RAWG also lists Warner Bros. Interactive), published by Warner Bros. Interactive, released 2011-03-25. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters follow the eight campaign Intervals named in the Steam achievement API names, plus chapters drawn from achievement themes.

chapters.title: Intervals 1 to 4: Prison to Village
chapters.summary: Clearing the first four Intervals (API names Prison, Slums, Store and Village), and the Poker Room headshots in Prison. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Intervals 5 to 8: Needle to Wade Island
chapters.summary: Clearing the last four Intervals (API names Needle, Bridge, Port Authority and Wade Island) and finishing the campaign. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Interval High Scores and Challenges
chapters.summary: Eight hidden high-score achievements, one per Interval, plus challenge points, 30 challenges in one Interval and every challenge.

chapters.title: INSANE Difficulty
chapters.summary: Finishing the campaign on INSANE and a clean INSANE run of one level.

chapters.title: Ranks and Alma Dolls
chapters.summary: Ranks 10 and 21, and the Alma Doll on every mission.

chapters.title: Co-op: Pointman and Fettel
chapters.summary: Psychic Links, killing and suspending enemies as a pair, and revives.

chapters.title: Contractions
chapters.summary: Waves, crates, deep fog and Last Stand feats in the Contractions mode.

chapters.title: Soul King
chapters.summary: Possessions, souls and round wins in Soul King.

chapters.title: Combat
chapters.summary: Kill counts, Slow-Mo, knives, kicks, sniper headshots, the crowbar and possessing every enemy type.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry "fear-3" (id 5565). The Steam store list has app 21100 ("F.E.A.R. 3"); its schema is named "ValveTestApp17200" (a placeholder name with a different number) and has 50 achievements, 17 hidden. StrategyWiki has no page under "F.E.A.R. 3", "F.E.A.R. III" or "FEAR 3". fear.fandom.com answers the API under "F.E.A.R. 3" with about 112 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The hidden achievements have no descriptions, but their API names name the Intervals: Complete_Prison, Complete_Slums, Complete_Store, Complete_Village, Complete_Needle, Complete_Bridge, Complete_Port_Authority and Complete_Wade_Island, with unlock rates falling in that order (74.4% to 37.1%), so that is taken as the campaign order; the split into two halves is our own choice. The eight hidden High_Score_ achievements sit in the scores chapter. "Mission... accomplished?" says "all Intervals complete", which is where the word Interval comes from. The hidden "Yo, Adrian!" (API name Melee_Hanging_Things, 4.2%) does not name an Interval and sits in combat as a guess. "Insider Trading" (possess every possessable enemy) sits in combat because the data does not say which character possesses.
